# Immersive Web Emulation Runtime (vendored)

`iwer.min.js` is the browser bundle of IWER 2.5.0 (`build/iwer.min.js` from the
`iwer` npm package, MIT, copyright Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates, see
LICENSE). It installs a spec-shaped `navigator.xr` from JavaScript so WebXR
sessions run in a browser with no headset, which is how this package's browser
tests and the web smoke lane exercise the real WebXR binding layer.

Two copies exist and a test keeps them identical. `test/support/iwer_bundle.g.dart`
holds this file base64-encoded for `flutter test --platform chrome`, generated by
`dart run tool/vendor_iwer.dart`; `examples/smoke_render/web/third_party/iwer/`
holds a plain copy the smoke app loads with a script tag. To update, replace this
file and LICENSE, rerun the tool, and copy the file into the smoke app.
